customManagers.description: Issue #70: a `run:` step is not a manifest, so no built-in manager sees exact `npm install -g <pkg>@X.Y.Z` pins in .github/workflows; match them so bumps go through minimumReleaseAge like every other dependency.

packageRules.description: Deno dependencies are governed by native Deno tooling (deno.json minimumDependencyAge), not Renovate; disable the deno manager so the two do not overlap.
